title: External Exception Review Timeframes by Formulary
content:
Under every formulary of the Formulary Benefit, a denied exception may go to external exception review by an independent review organization. The reviewer's timeframes are counted in hours from its receipt of the review.

| Term | Exclusive | Value | Standard | Preferred Drug List | Broad | Open |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| External exception review available after a denial | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Standard external review decided within (hours from receipt) | 72 | 72 | 72 | 72 | 72 | 72 |
| Expedited external review decided within (hours from receipt) | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 |

The columns are the Northbridge Exclusive Formulary, Northbridge Value Formulary, Northbridge Standard Formulary, Northbridge Preferred Drug List, Northbridge Broad Formulary and Northbridge Open Formulary.

*Expressed in days.* A standard external review is 72 hours, which is three days of twenty-four hours. An expedited external review is 24 hours, which is one day.

*Hypothetical.* Suppose the independent reviewer receives a standard review at 15:00 on the 3rd of a month. Its decision is due by 15:00 on the 6th.
